deliberately_left_alone: scripts/agent-lint-md.sh: lint-md-links leg (lychee) — left as skip_notice/exit 0 on absent binary. Rationale documented inline in the script: lychee is a separate cargo-installed Rust binary (not part of the node_modules symlink convention that made markdownlint-cli2 trivially available), it is not the tool implicated in the TC-37 incident (that was markdownlint-cli2 missing 9 real structural errors), and its own online/offline modality already signals partial/best-effort coverage by design. Hard-failing it would break every worktree that has not run full scripts/bootstrap.sh for a check whose degraded-skip is an accepted, pre-existing product of its own design, not a regression.
